parsed.incumbent_segment: First-listed receptacle probe for target acquisition when the target is not visible at entry
parsed.warrant: The incumbent demonstrates that first-listed probing achieves target acquisition on this trial, but the absence of any comparative test leaves open whether a different search heuristic would be more efficient across the task scope, making this comparison worth instantiating.

parsed.guidance: Navigate directly to an available open surface receptacle. Inspect its contents for the target object type. If present, take it. If absent, terminate this local probe to allow fallback search strategies.
parsed.hypothesis: Prioritizing navigation to an open surface receptacle first avoids the overhead of opening closed storage receptacles, yielding faster target acquisition when the object may be resting on a visible surface.

probe_spec.adaptive_policy: From the current observation, select any admissible navigation action targeting an open surface receptacle. Upon arrival, inspect the returned observation for the target object type. If the target is listed as present, issue a take action for it. If the target is not present or the receptacle is empty, stop the probe immediately without attempting further receptacles.
probe_spec.evidence_goal: Observation confirming the target object was successfully taken from the open surface receptacle, or confirmation that the open surface did not contain the target, discriminating whether open-surface-first search is more efficient than closed-receptacle-first search.
probe_spec.local_function: Select and navigate to a receptacle, expose its contents, and acquire the target object if present.
probe_spec.realization_pattern: Navigate to an open surface receptacle from the room center, inspect for the target object type, and take it if found; otherwise abort local probe.
probe_spec.required_downstream_state: Target object held in inventory; agent located at the receptacle where the object was found.
stop_conditions: Target object successfully taken into inventory
Open surface receptacle reached and target object confirmed absent
Navigation action fails or returns error
